TournamentDocument.title: TournamentDocument
TournamentDocument.description: Persisted live state of the SGHS-23 Cricket Tournament Season 2 including teams, 24 players across Groups A-G, draft reveals, match scorecards, and tournament logo.

logoDataUrl.description: Compressed data URL for custom tournament logo

activeMatchId.description: ID of the currently active match in the scoreboard

activeDraftGroup.description: Currently revealing draft group A-G or empty string when idle

players.description: Bounded list of 24 tournament players (3 captains + 21 grouped players)

teams.description: Bounded list of 3 competing tournament teams

draftGroups.description: Map of draft reveal states for Groups A through G

matches.description: Bounded list of 4 tournament matches (3 Round-Robin + 1 Grand Final)

notifications.description: Bounded list of recent live tournament notifications

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the tournament organizer who created the document

status.description: Lifecycle status of the tournament document

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the tournament document was initialized

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the tournament document was last updated

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted admin role assignment record keyed by user UID

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of admin record creation

/tournaments/{tournamentId}.description: Stores live tournament state documents keyed by tournamentId (e.g., sghs23_season2)
